question: With the whole project in one prompt (128K serving, same prompt as DeepSeek R), how close does Nemotron get to DeepSeek 36/36? Single agent (L1F) and arbiter-free swarm of 8 (L8F).

policy_text.L1F: one whole-bundle call (prompt identical to R) -> if diagnosis but no FILE blocks: one format follow-up asking for FILE blocks only -> public self-check -> one repair on failure; FILE-marker normalization (glued/unterminated headers, END FILE with path)
policy_text.L8F: 8 independent L1F agents; selection valid -> passes public tests -> largest cluster of identical normalized diffs -> earliest
